fields.label: Security Deposit Account
fields.description: Liability account where security deposits are held (e.g. 'Security Deposits Received')

fields.label: Rent Item Code
fields.description: ERPNext Item used when auto-generating rent Sales Invoices (e.g. 'Monthly Rent')

fields.label: Default Sale Item
fields.description: Item used on payment-plan invoices when a Property Unit has no ERPNext Item of its own. Set one non-stock item here and bookings invoice without per-unit setup.

fields.label: Enable Late Fees
fields.description: Automatically charge late fees on overdue Payment Plan milestones

fields.label: Grace Period (Days)
fields.description: Days after due date before late fee is applied

fields.label: Late Fee (%)
fields.description: Late fee as a percentage of the outstanding milestone amount

fields.label: Late Fee Item Code
fields.description: ERPNext Item used when generating late fee Sales Invoices

fields.label: Bill Booking Amount as First Instalment
fields.description: The booking's Booking Amount becomes the first instalment, due on the booking date; the rest of the agreement value follows the payment plan template, earliest milestones reduced first. Off: the plan is the template alone and Booking Amount is informational.

fields.label: Adjust Advances Against New Instalment Invoices
fields.description: A token or advance already received from the customer (a Payment Entry not yet against any invoice) is set off against each instalment invoice as it is raised.

fields.label: Buyer TDS Receivable Account
fields.description: TDS the buyer deducts on property purchases (India: section 194-IA). A receipt recorded with a TDS amount closes the invoice in full and books the deducted part here, to be claimed against Form 16B.

fields.label: Buyer TDS Threshold (Agreement Value)
fields.description: TDS is suggested only for bookings whose agreement value is at least this much. 0 = every booking.

fields.label: Forfeit on Cancellation
fields.options:
None
Booking Amount
Percentage of Agreement Value
Percentage of Amount Paid
Fixed Amount
fields.description: How much of what the customer paid is kept when a booking is cancelled. Never more than they actually paid.

fields.label: Forfeit Percentage / Amount
fields.depends_on: eval:['Percentage of Agreement Value','Percentage of Amount Paid','Fixed Amount'].includes(doc.cancellation_forfeit_basis)

fields.label: Commission Calculated On
fields.description: The amount a percentage Commission Rule applies to.

fields.label: Commission Payable Account (Employees)
fields.description: Settlements for employees are booked by Journal Entry: expense debited, this account credited against the Employee.

fields.label: Brokerage Item (Channel Partners)
fields.description: Settlements for channel partners raise a draft Purchase Invoice with this item; TDS (194H) and GST come from the Supplier and the bill.

fields.label: Payment Instructions
fields.description: Shown to customers and staff when no payment gateway is enabled -- bank account, UPI ID, cheque in favour of.

fields.label: Allowed Return Hosts
fields.description: Where a payment link may send the customer after paying (the return_url your frontend passes). One host per line, e.g. app.example.com or https://app.example.com. This site is always allowed.

fields.label: Enable WhatsApp OTP
fields.description: Send password reset OTPs via WhatsApp Message DocType when customer mobile_no is available
